latest.title: The real quotient of the Cartwright-Steger surface
latest.abstract: Borisov and Yeung showed that the Cartwright-Steger surface $X$ is defined over ${\mathbb {Q}}$, hence complex conjugation gives an antiholomorphic involution on $X$. We show that the orbit space $Y$ is a closed oriented smooth four-manifold homeomorphic to ${\mathbb {CP}}^2\# (S^1 \times S^3)$, presenting $X$ as a double branched cover $X\to Y$, with branch locus diffeomorphic to the connected sum of three copies of the real projective plane.
latest.topic: 几何拓扑、低维流形与结
latest.workSummary: 确定 Cartwright–Steger 曲面复共轭商的四维拓扑类型，并描述其分支覆盖。
latest.breakthrough: 将商空间识别为 CP² 与 S¹×S³ 的连通和，分支集为三个实射影平面的连通和。
latest.limitations: 商空间的同胚分类不应表述为已确定所有光滑结构。 当前为摘要级分析，技术细节与结论须回查原文。
latest.aiEvidence: 用 ChatGPT、Claude 支持探索计算、文字修订及 GAP 脚本。
latest.priorityReason: 为特殊复曲面提供具体拓扑模型，影响主要集中在四维几何拓扑。
